question: Why did the fresh RC100 1002 X episode finish at 777.971 as an emergency after a conditional suffix of 601.364, and why did all 12 S cells move, including R100 1002 S from hard H to emergency?
method: Saved M48 and M49 executions and their first-recovery init logs only. No new search, no witness flag list, no seeds 4001-4030.
same_first_visible_cut: 36/36. Nominal cost and z match, and replan 1 has the same cut time and the same observed parcel.
conditional_pickle: The 601.364/563.508 diagnostics optimized a later saved visible snapshot. That snapshot is not the state this fresh episode had reached. The fresh episode had already selected a different plan at replan 1.
reorder_at_first_recovery: A feasible evaluation immediately after H_EXCEEDED occurred only for C50 1002 S, R50 1001 S, and RC50 1002 S. It did not occur for RC100 1002 X or R100 1002 S. The geometric reorder is not the first-recovery adopter on those two cells.
what_changed_before_alns: On the shared cut, the first catalog evaluation is already slightly cheaper in M49 while makespan is often unchanged. The rest of the 100 init evaluations change character: energy rejects become feasible plans or hard-H and custody rejects. That happens before main ALNS. Both blanket landed=True on every sortie and the truck-field sync are applied to those candidates. The saved logs do not separate those two edits.
kept: unstarted truck equals the launch visit truck
started fragment truck equals the recovery visit, launch_truck preserved
dropped: marking every sortie in a catalog candidate landed
not_claimed: This patch is not asserted to restore 32/36 hard H or to beat M48. The paid check below is not authorized yet.
